evidence.text: Implemented work.py evaluate(request, policy): copies defaults, applies layers in order, rejects unknown keys, supports policy-controlled null resets, exact boolean/integer/string typing (excluding bool as int), and policy-controlled environment parsing with exact true/false and signed-decimal integers. Generated report.json from the current policy.json and requests.json. Verified compilation, report generation, explicit false/zero/empty-string preservation, reset behavior, type errors, unknown keys, environment gating, and valid/invalid environment parsing.

Unresolved limit: the task does not specify malformed request/policy container behavior (for example non-list layers, non-object layers, or defaults/types disagreement), so implementation targets valid structural inputs. It accepts either request.environment or the prior-compatible request.env alias; if both are present, environment takes precedence. No evidence.json is present in this work sample.

Milestone complete: work.py implements layered configuration evaluation and report.json matches current requests.json/policy.json. Verified with py_compile, generated-report equality, and comprehensive assertions covering ordered layers, false/zero/empty preservation, null reset policy, unknown keys, strict types (bool excluded from integer), environment gating, exact lowercase booleans, ASCII signed-decimal integers, and invalid environment inputs. Remaining limit: malformed request/policy container behavior is unspecified; implementation assumes structurally valid inputs.
